summary: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd., a Taiwan-based semiconductor assembly and test services provider, furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC on August 3, 2026. The filing contains the company's consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with an independent auditors' review report by Deloitte & Touche. There is no announcement of a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special-situation event. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, providing only financial results and related audit opinions. No terms, transactions, or strategic actions are mentioned that would qualify as a special situation.
